lewisburg.title: Lewisburg, West Virginia
lewisburg.pose: 37.800861, −80.444100 · 64.60° true northeast · 61.66° horizontal field of view
lewisburg.seen: The model places the post office’s projecting corner and the double yellow centerline in view. Its near corner appears about one-sixth of a frame too far right. Its pale facade, even row of square windows and dry pavement differ from the photograph’s red brick, tall windows and rain-darkened street.
lewisburg.measurement: The closest-in-time Greenbrier Valley Airport report (KLWB), 7.5 km away and 4 min 34 sec after the photograph, recorded broken cloud and light rain. The offline replay uses its cloud cover and the shutter-time sun. At 640 × 480, mean absolute RGB error across the upper fifth fell from 78.6 in the game to 31.5 in the replay on a 0–255 scale. Across the full frame it fell from 59.7 to 37.8. On the foreground road it rose from 11.4 to 17.3. The replay changes illumination only.
lewisburg.author: Antony-22 · “Lewisburg, West Virginia post office 2016” · July 8, 2016, 22:50:26 UTC (GPS)
lewisburg.camera: The iPhone 6 recorded true-north direction and a 29 mm equivalent lens. Horizontal field of view uses the photograph’s 4:3 aspect ratio. The camera was 213 m from the original sample point. Height, pitch, roll and position accuracy were unreported. Both towns use a 1.65 m level camera.

archive.solar_caption: Offline control · shutter-time sun and default clouds
archive.control_note: With the same shutter-time sun in both renders, changing only the cloud input reduced the upper-fifth error from 89.4 to 31.5. The airport also recorded light rain before the shutter. The station cannot establish conditions at the photographer’s precise position.

bethel.title: Bethel, Maine
bethel.pose: 44.408000, −70.793333 · 25.65° true northeast · approx. 61° horizontal field of view
bethel.seen: The two wings of Gould Academy’s Davidson Hall meet at a recess in both views. The reference has warm red brick, shaded grass, footpaths and a tree on the left. The game puts a tree on the right and blends most of the lawn and paths into one blurred surface.
bethel.measurement: This comparison checks the building plan and grounds visually. The phone supplied its position, true-north compass direction and 3.85 mm focal length. The horizontal field of view is estimated from the iPhone 4 sensor width. The shutter date is June 2012, and the game uses its standard reference afternoon. The camera was about 447 m from the original sample point, 2.7 m from the mapped Church Street centerline. Pitch, roll, height and GPS accuracy were unreported.
bethel.author: User:Nickline4 · “Gould Academy Davidson Hall” · June 29, 2012, 18:44:36 UTC (GPS)
